items.q: Benny and I were pretty close friends

ctx.x: Then they had -- you know, the that too, started - actually their tunes, (unintelligible) -- I've met so many people come from different parts of the country that could play, like -- well, say like St. Louis and then Louisville, Kentucky -- and they had a style around Chicago, style was the one that impressed me for clarinet playing (unintelligible) Darnell gible) was Darnell Howard. Now, I didn't know that Darnell Howard and Benny Carter was cousins until I read it in John Chilton's book, John Chilton's book.
